item.title: 赛力斯回应问界撤出华为门店传闻：部分门店将继续销售
item.guid: 赛力斯回应问界撤出华为门店传闻：部分门店将继续销售
item.description:
According to a September 17 report by Red Star Capital Bureau, Seres denied claims that AITO would withdraw from HarmonyOS Smart Travel and Huawei exclusive stores starting next January, stating that "some stores will be retained" and that some HarmonyOS Smart Travel and Huawei exclusive stores will continue to sell AITO vehicles. 据红星资本局 9 月 17 日报道，针对问界将从明年 1 月起撤出鸿蒙智行和华为专卖店的消息，赛力斯方面否认了这一说法，表示「有部分门店是保留的」，部分鸿蒙智行和华为专卖店会继续销售问界。

Previously, Jiemian News cited Huawei channel sources as saying that multiple dealers had received notice that starting next year, they would need to independently choose between Huawei, the other four HarmonyOS Smart Travel brands, and AITO for代理 brands. AITO would retain existing delivery centers to handle delivery and after-sales services. 此前，界面新闻援引华为渠道消息称，多位经销商收到通知，明年起需在华为、鸿蒙智行其余四个品牌与问界之间自主选择代理品牌，问界会保留现有交付中心，承担交付和售后。

Seres further told Red Star Capital Bureau that Huawei has not withdrawn from AITO, and that their technical supply, business cooperation, and equity ties still exist. AITO will continue to use Huawei's intelligent technology; AITO will still be available in Huawei's hypermarket stores, most of which belong to Huawei's digital channel partners, and Huawei still retains control over this part. 赛力斯向红星资本局进一步表示，华为没有撤出问界，双方的技术供应、商业合作和股权联系仍然存在，问界将继续使用华为智能化技术；华为商超店里仍会有问界，大部分商超店属于华为数码渠道商，这部分主导权仍在华为。

According to the new cooperation model announced by both parties on September 15, AITO's product definition, design, brand marketing, channel retail, and service system will be led by Seres, with Huawei Terminal participating in empowerment. AITO remains a member of HarmonyOS Smart Travel, and existing user rights and subsequent services will not be affected; the other four brands will continue to adopt Huawei's full-process dominant model. 根据双方 9 月 15 日公布的新合作模式，问界的产品定义、设计、品牌营销、渠道零售和服务体系改由赛力斯主导，华为终端参与赋能。问界仍是鸿蒙智行成员，用户既有权益和后续服务不受影响；其余四个品牌继续采用华为全流程主导模式。

item.title: 罗福莉直播公开小米 MiMo-V2.6 训练，两款模型累计成本超 135 万美元
item.guid: 罗福莉直播公开小米-MiMo-V2.6-训练，两款模型累计成本超-135-万美元
item.description:
Luo Fuli, head of Xiaomi MiMo, disclosed the reinforcement learning training progress of MiMo-V2.6 and opened a real-time training panel. The page displays the running status of the Pro and Flash versions, including training steps, token consumption, sample quantity, cost, and internal metrics. 小米 MiMo 负责人罗福莉公开了 MiMo-V2.6 的强化学习训练进展，并开放实时训练面板。页面展示 Pro 与 Flash 两个版本的运行状态，包括训练步骤、token 消耗、样本数量、成本和内部指标。

According to Jiemian News, as of the afternoon of September 17, the cumulative training cost of the two models had exceeded $1.35 million, totaling approximately $31,000 per hour. The training page is still being continuously updated, and the models are still in the reinforcement learning process. 据界面新闻报道，截至 9 月 17 日下午发稿，两款模型的累计训练成本已超过 135 万美元，合计每小时花费约 3.1 万美元。训练页面目前仍在持续更新，模型还处于强化学习过程之中。

Luo Fuli stated that the team is simultaneously expanding computational resources, training environments, task systems, and evaluation computations. Each training step uses approximately 2 billion tokens, running completely asynchronously with a configuration of 1568 prompts and 16 attempts per prompt, mixing multiple agent task frameworks into the same training round. 罗福莉表示，团队正同时扩大计算资源、训练环境与任务体系，以及评估计算。每个训练步骤使用约 20 亿个 token，按 1568 个提示、每个提示 16 次尝试的配置完全异步运行，并将多个智能体任务框架混合到同一轮训练。

The evaluation mechanism combines test cases and scoring rules to assign rewards for different execution paths. The Xiaomi MiMo team plans to gradually release technical details in the coming weeks; the real-time panel displays the current training process, not the final performance of officially released models. 评估机制结合测试用例与评分细则，为不同执行路径分配奖励。小米 MiMo 团队计划在未来几周陆续公开技术细节；实时面板展示的是本轮训练过程，不是已正式发布模型的最终成绩。

🔗 Related reading: Luo Fuli also learns from Lei Jun to do live streaming! Xiaomi's new model training publicly revealed for the first time, burning 200,000 in an hour 🔗 相关阅读： 罗福莉也学雷军玩直播！小米新模型训练首次公开，一小时狂烧 20 万

item.title: Anthropic 披露研发指标：Claude 主导 26% 的 AI 研发工作
item.guid: Anthropic-披露研发指标：Claude-主导-26%-的-AI-研发工作
item.description:
On September 17, Anthropic unveiled a set of metrics to measure the R&D progress of frontier AI labs, covering the extent of AI involvement in R&D, agent supervision mechanisms, and compute allocation. Anthropic 9 月 17 日公开一组衡量前沿 AI 实验室研发进度的指标，涵盖 AI 参与研发的程度、智能体监督机制和算力分配。

The company disclosed that as of August this year, Claude had "led" 26% of AI R&D work, with over 90% of the work reaching "AI collaboration" or higher levels. Here, "led" means AI can complete most tasks based on high-level prompts, still under human supervision; among all measured R&D work subsets, there are no fully autonomous projects yet. 公司披露，截至今年 8 月，Claude 已「主导」26% 的 AI 研发工作，超过 90% 的工作达到「AI 协作」或更高等级。这里的「主导」指 AI 可根据高层提示完成大部分任务，仍由人类监督；所有被测量的研发工作子集中，尚没有完全自主运行的项目。

On its most frequently used internal platform, approximately 30,000 agents are engaged in research and engineering work at any given time. All agent actions on this platform undergo online monitoring before execution and offline monitoring after execution; in over 1 billion decisions made in August, approximately 0.002% were intercepted by online monitoring. 在其最常用的内部平台上，任一时点约有 3 万个智能体从事研究和工程工作。该平台的所有智能体动作都会经过执行前在线监控和执行后离线监控；8 月超过 10 亿次决策中，约 0.002% 被在线监控拦截。

Compute power samples were taken from July 13th to 20th: approximately 6% of AI R&D compute power was used for safety work, and the corresponding proportion in AI-driven R&D compute power was about 12%. Anthropic emphasizes that the proportion of compute power cannot directly measure the effectiveness of safety investments, and classification methods also have errors; the company plans to introduce independent third-party verification metrics and safety practices. 算力样本取自 7 月 13 日至 20 日：AI 研发算力中约 6% 用于安全工作，AI 驱动研发算力中的相应比例约为 12%。Anthropic 强调，算力比例不能直接衡量安全投入成效，分类方法也存在误差；公司计划引入独立第三方核验指标和安全实践。

item.title: 豆包座舱助手发布，荣威家越 07 将率先搭载
item.guid: 豆包座舱助手发布，荣威家越-07-将率先搭载
item.description:
On September 17, Doubao and Volcano Engine jointly released the Doubao Cockpit Assistant and announced a partnership with SAIC Group. The first model to be equipped, the Roewe Jiayue 07, is about to begin pre-sales, and related SAIC Audi models are also planned to debut within the year. 9 月 17 日，豆包与火山引擎联合发布豆包座舱助手，并宣布与上汽集团合作。首款搭载车型荣威家越 07 即将开启预售，上汽奥迪相关车型也计划在年内亮相。

According to the official introduction, car owners can remotely control vehicles, check vehicle status, and push planned itineraries from conversations to the car's infotainment system via the Doubao App. The cockpit assistant can sense hundreds of vehicle signals, utilize vehicle control, navigation, assisted driving, and entertainment capabilities, and break down complex tasks for step-by-step execution. 据官方介绍，车主可以在豆包 App 中远程控制车辆、查询车况，并将对话中规划的行程推送到车机。座舱助手能感知数百种车辆信号，调用车控、导航、辅助驾驶和娱乐等整车能力，将复杂任务拆解后分步执行。

In-car interaction supports four-zone voice recognition: after any zone is activated, all passengers in the car can continue the conversation without repeated activation. The system also has long-term memory, capable of saving different passengers' preferences and custom habits. 车内交互支持四音区识别：任一音区唤醒后，全车乘客可以继续对话，无需重复唤醒。系统还具备长期记忆，可以保存不同乘客的偏好与自定义习惯。

Volcano Engine also unveiled the in-car "Doubao Screen," allowing Doubao to appear as a permanent character in the car, with its expressions changing with chat content. 火山引擎同时公布了车载「豆包屏」，让豆包以常驻形象出现在车内，并随聊天内容变化表情。

item.title: OpenAI 将定期披露模型异常行为，首批公开 6 份报告
item.guid: OpenAI-将定期披露模型异常行为，首批公开-6-份报告
item.description:
According to Reuters, OpenAI has unveiled a new framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment behaviors, along with six preliminary reports. The company stated that as AI system capabilities grow, the industry has yet to solve critical alignment challenges. 据路透社报道，OpenAI 公布了一套追踪、调查和披露模型失准行为的新框架，并公开 6 份初步报告。公司表示，随着 AI 系统能力增强，行业仍未解决关键的对齐难题。

The reports cover behaviors such as models hiding errors from users, leaving instructions for future versions, uploading files to the internet to create citations, and exchanging information via software repositories or websites. In one case, an unreleased model sent unauthorized instructions to an agent during training, asking it to ignore OpenAI's requirements and conceal the fact that it completed tasks by cheating. The earliest case dates back to last October. 报告涉及模型向用户隐藏错误、为未来版本留下指令、把文件上传至互联网以制造引用，以及通过软件仓库或网站交换信息等行为。其中一个案例里，尚未发布的模型在训练中向智能体发送未经授权的指令，要求它忽略 OpenAI 的要求，隐瞒通过作弊完成任务的情况。最早的案例可追溯至去年 10 月。

Under the new process, employees can report suspected incidents, which will be investigated by the safety and alignment teams, and then a decision will be made on whether to disclose them based on disclosure standards. OpenAI hopes to report abnormal behaviors more quickly even when they are not fully explained; complex incidents involving third parties will enter a different investigation process. 按照新流程，员工可以上报疑似事件，由安全和对齐团队调查，再依据披露标准决定是否公开。OpenAI 希望在异常行为尚未被完全解释时，也能更快作出报告；涉及第三方的复杂事件则进入另一类调查流程。

The company also emphasized that these reports describe individual cases and cannot be used to determine the frequency of model misalignment behaviors, nor are they a complete list of all known or still-under-investigation incidents. The Hugging Face incident disclosed in July this year will fall into the category of complex investigations requiring third-party involvement. 公司同时强调，这些报告描述的是个别案例，不能据此判断模型失准行为出现的频率，也不是所有已知或仍在调查事件的完整清单。今年 7 月披露的 Hugging Face 事件，将属于需要第三方参与的复杂调查类别。

item.title: 华为昇腾 960 提前至明年一季度推出，超节点扩至 4096 卡
item.guid: 华为昇腾-960-提前至明年一季度推出，超节点扩至-4096-卡
item.description:
On September 17, at Huawei Connect, David Wang, Huawei's Deputy Chairman and Rotating Chairman, unveiled a new roadmap for Ascend chips: Ascend 960DT will be launched in the first quarter of 2027, three quarters ahead of schedule; 960PR and Atlas 960 liquid-cooled nodes are planned for release in the third quarter. Ascend 970 and 980 are scheduled for 2028 and 2029, respectively. 9 月 17 日，在华为全联接大会上，华为副董事长、轮值董事长汪涛公布了昇腾芯片的新路线图：昇腾 960DT 将于 2027 年第一季度推出，比原计划提前三个季度；960PR 和 Atlas 960 液冷节点计划在第三季度推出。昇腾 970、980 分别安排在 2028 年、2029 年。

Huawei also announced the Ascend 960 SuperNode, which uses NPO technology. A single node supports 4096 cards and connects via the Lingqu architecture and Hi-ONE optical engine. Huawei states that the system has a round-trip communication latency of 2 microseconds and can support the training and inference of 10 trillion parameter models. 华为还公布了采用 NPO 技术的昇腾 960 超节点，单节点支持 4096 张卡，通过灵衢架构与 Hi-ONE 光引擎连接。华为称，该系统的往返通信时延为 2 微秒，可支持 10 万亿参数模型的训练和推理。

David Wang stated that the performance of Ascend 960 will double. The aforementioned chips and supernodes are currently part of the announced product roadmap, with delivery times set for next year. 汪涛表示，昇腾 960 的性能将实现倍增。上述芯片和超节点目前属于公布的产品路线图，交付时间分别落在明年。

Huawei's official introduction also unveiled the Kunpeng SuperNode and OceanStor M900 AI Memory Storage: the former supports a maximum of 4096 nodes and a 256TB unified memory pool, while the latter provides PB-level KV cache for agents and long-sequence inference. 华为官方介绍还公布了鲲鹏超节点和 OceanStor M900 AI 记忆存储：前者最大支持 4096 个节点、256TB 统一内存池，后者为智能体和长序列推理提供 PB 级 KV 缓存。

By interconnecting intelligent computing, general computing, and caching systems equally through the Lingqu UnifiedBus, Huawei states that clusters can be expanded to 512,000 cards, and with multi-track topology, can support up to 1 million cards. 通过灵衢 UnifiedBus 将智算、通算和缓存系统平等互联，华为称集群可扩至 51.2 万卡，结合多轨道拓扑最大支持 100 万卡。

item.title: 曝 Manus 正商谈融资 5 亿美元，估值拟达 40 亿美元
item.guid: 曝-Manus-正商谈融资-5-亿美元，估值拟达-40-亿美元
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Manus is in talks with investors for a new funding round, planning to raise $500 million at a target valuation of approximately $4 billion, double its previous valuation. 据彭博社报道，Manus 正与投资者商谈新一轮融资，计划募集 5 亿美元，目标估值约 40 亿美元，为此前估值的两倍。

This will be Manus's first time seeking funding since its spin-off from Meta. The report, citing sources, states that this funding round is planned to be completed soon, but discussions are still ongoing, and specific terms may change. 这将是 Manus 与 Meta 拆分后首次寻求融资。报道援引知情人士称，这轮融资计划近期完成，但讨论仍在进行，具体条款可能变化。

The identity of new investors is not yet clear; Tencent, Sequoia China, and ZhenFund are its existing investors. 新投资者的身份尚未明确，腾讯、红杉中国和真格基金是其现有投资者。

item.title: 恒大汽车退出汽车制造，上半年转向电池贸易
item.guid: 恒大汽车退出汽车制造，上半年转向电池贸易
item.description:
Evergrande Auto disclosed its interim results on September 17, confirming its exit from the automotive manufacturing business and no intention to resume it. The company's production facilities in China have been sold or are being disposed of through sales or bankruptcy procedures. Going forward, it will conduct asset-light technology and battery trading businesses through its Hong Kong headquarters and Sweden's NEVS. 恒大汽车 9 月 17 日披露中期业绩，确认已退出汽车制造业务，也无意恢复。公司在中国的生产设施已出售，或正通过出售、破产程序处置，今后将经香港总部与瑞典 NEVS 开展轻资产技术及电池贸易业务。

For the six months ended June 30, 2026, the group's unaudited revenue was 8.725 million yuan, with a net profit of approximately 186 million yuan during the period. The profit includes approximately 555 million yuan in other income, mainly from exchange gains on borrowings. Total liabilities at the end of the period were approximately 32.722 billion yuan. 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的六个月，集团未经审核收入为 872.5 万元，期内净利润约 1.86 亿元。利润包含约 5.55 亿元其他收益，主要来自借款的汇兑收益。期末总负债约 327.22 亿元。

The announcement stated that battery trade has achieved its first sales, procuring cylindrical and prismatic cells for the two-wheeler, power tool, energy storage, and small home appliance markets in Europe and Southeast Asia. New customers are required to settle in full cash, and business is organized by order. 公告称，电池贸易已实现首次销售，采购圆柱及方形电芯，面向欧洲和东南亚的两轮车、电动工具、储能及小家电市场。新客户须全额现金结算，业务按订单组织采购。

The company is still in talks with independent investors for financing and discussing debt restructuring with the liquidators of its parent company; the announcement also warned of significant going concern uncertainties. Evergrande Auto shares have been suspended from trading since April 1, 2025, and have not yet resumed. 公司仍在与独立投资者洽谈融资，并与母公司的清盘人讨论债务重组；公告同时提示重大持续经营不确定性。恒大汽车股票自 2025 年 4 月 1 日起停牌，目前仍未恢复交易。

item.title: 零跑：近期不重点投入人形机器人，更看好非人形方案
item.guid: 零跑：近期不重点投入人形机器人，更看好非人形方案
item.description:
On September 17, Zhu Jiangming, founder of Leapmotor, stated during a media exchange at Technology Day that the company's humanoid robot is still in the pre-research stage and has made some demonstrations, but will not focus on humanoids in the near future. 9 月 17 日，零跑汽车创始人朱江明在技术日媒体交流中表示，公司的人形机器人仍处于预研阶段，做了一些演示，但近期不会把人形作为重点方向。

According to reports, Leapmotor's humanoid robot has entered the testing phase, with core underlying capabilities such as motors, controllers, batteries, perception algorithms, and computing platforms all being self-developed. Currently, it maintains small-scale investment to explore scalable applications. 据报道，零跑的人形机器人已经进入测试阶段，电机、控制器、电池、感知算法与计算平台等底层能力均为自研，目前保持小规模投入，探索可规模化落地的应用。

Zhu Jiangming believes that robots still need a growth process from being able to walk and run to performing actual work, and it is currently difficult to determine a business model. He is more optimistic about mobile and operable non-humanoid robots, such as wheeled and deformable solutions, and compares them to cycling and walking: cycling 30 kilometers is less strenuous than walking the same distance; to complete work, the structure should be simplified as much as possible and costs reduced. 朱江明认为，机器人从能走能跑到实际工作，还需要成长过程，目前很难确定商业模式。他更看好能移动、能操作的非人形机器人，例如轮式、可变形方案，并用骑车与步行作比较：骑自行车 30 公里，比步行同样距离更省力；完成工作应尽量简化结构、降低成本。

Don't hype concepts; choose the right time to implement. A robot that can merely be walked around is not impressive; only a robot that can make money is truly worthwhile.

He stated that Leapmotor will focus more on automation scenarios in the near future, utilizing AI and existing technologies to explore innovative products and a second growth curve. 他表示，零跑近期会更关注自动化场景，利用 AI 和已有技术探索创新产品及第二增长曲线。

item.title: 地瓜机器人完成 4 亿美元 C 轮融资，继续投入芯片与开发平台
item.guid: 地瓜机器人完成-4-亿美元-C-轮融资，继续投入芯片与开发平台
item.description:
Digua Robot announced on September 17 that it has completed a $400 million Series C funding round, led by Mirae Asset, with participation from Meituan Strategic Investment and others, and over half of its existing shareholders continuing to increase their stakes. 地瓜机器人 9 月 17 日宣布完成 4 亿美元 C 轮融资，由未来资产领投，美团战投等参与，超过半数老股东继续加注。

The company stated that this round of funding will be used to complete the full computing power product layout of the Xuri chip and build a software platform covering data collection, training, simulation, and deployment to serve robot developers. Digua Robot primarily provides computing chips and software/hardware development platforms, not focusing on complete machine manufacturing. 公司表示，本轮资金将用于补齐旭日芯片的全算力产品布局，并建设覆盖数据采集、训练、仿真与部署的软件平台，服务机器人开发者。地瓜机器人主要提供计算芯片和软硬件开发底座，不以整机制造为主营方向。

According to company disclosures, cumulative chip shipments have exceeded 8 million units. The Xuri S600, launched in November 2025, has been adopted by over 20 leading customers, with multiple projects entering mass production and shipment phases; revenue in the first half of this year achieved several-fold growth. 据公司披露，芯片累计出货已超过 800 万片。2025 年 11 月推出的旭日 S600 已被超过 20 家头部客户采用，多个项目进入量产出货阶段；今年上半年营收实现数倍增长。

item.title: Crusoe F 轮预计融资 39 亿美元，投后估值达 309 亿美元
item.guid: Crusoe-F-轮预计融资-39-亿美元，投后估值达-309-亿美元
item.description:
On September 17, AI infrastructure company Crusoe announced the initial closing of its Series F funding round, which is expected to raise $3.9 billion, valuing the company at $30.9 billion post-investment. Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital, and Valor Equity Partners co-led the round, with participation from Nvidia, GIC, Qatar Investment Authority, and others. 9 月 17 日，AI 基础设施公司 Crusoe 宣布完成 F 轮融资的初次交割，本轮预计募资 39 亿美元，投后估值为 309 亿美元。Atreides Management、Mubadala Capital 和 Valor Equity Partners 联合领投，英伟达、GIC、卡塔尔投资局等参与。

The funds will be used to expand existing projects, build large AI data center campuses and modular Crusoe Spark facilities, and scale Crusoe Cloud. The company integrates power development, data center construction, and cloud services within the same platform, developing its own power projects and collaborating with suppliers such as power grids, energy storage, and nuclear energy. 资金将用于扩展现有项目、建设大型 AI 数据中心园区及模块化 Crusoe Spark 设施，并扩大 Crusoe Cloud。公司把电力开发、数据中心建设和云服务放在同一平台内，自行开发电力项目，并与电网、储能、核能等供应商合作。

Crusoe stated that the total contract value of its platform exceeds $140 billion, with a total contracted capacity of over 6GW for data center and cloud businesses, of which approximately 1GW has been delivered and is operational. The total contract value refers to the scale of signed business, not confirmed revenue. Crusoe 表示，其平台合同总价值超过 1400 亿美元，数据中心与云业务的签约总容量超过 6GW，其中约 1GW 已交付并投入运行。合同总价值统计的是已签约业务规模，并非已确认营收。

Modular Spark data centers are manufactured in the United States, allowing customers to increase capacity in batches as needed. The company stated that Crusoe Cloud bookings have grown by over 20 times year-over-year since the beginning of this year, and Cognition, Figure, and Perplexity are already using its cloud services. 模块化 Spark 数据中心在美国制造，客户可以随需求分批增加容量。公司称，今年以来 Crusoe Cloud 预订量同比增长超过 20 倍，Cognition、Figure 和 Perplexity 已使用其云服务。

item.title: 💡 于东来：给家人的开支不超收入三成，先学会为自己而活
item.guid: 💡-于东来：给家人的开支不超收入三成，先学会为自己而活
item.description:
According to Jiemian News, Yu Donglai live-streamed the internal employee basketball final on the evening of September 15 on his personal account and interacted with employees before the game. He suggested that income spent on parents and children should not exceed 30%, reminding employees to first learn to live for themselves. 据界面新闻报道，于东来在个人账号直播了 9 月 15 日晚的内部员工篮球赛总决赛，并在赛前与员工交流。他建议，收入用于父母、孩子的开支不超过 30%，提醒员工先懂得为自己而活。

Yu Donglai believes that excessively taking on family responsibilities can overdraw one's own life and easily lead to spoiling the next generation, losing the ability to pursue a happy life. He repeatedly reminded employees to first learn to love themselves: 于东来认为，过度承担家庭责任会透支自身生活，也容易造成对下一代的溺爱，失去追求快乐生活的能力。他反复提醒员工，要先学会爱自己：

Don't just earn wages here to support your children; that way, you'll fall behind. You must first understand how to live for yourself.

He stated that only by maintaining a confident and relaxed state can one manage a family well. He also hopes that the company's benefits will enable employees to live a good life, "rather than just helping everyone live a life of hardship." 他表示，保持自信与舒展的状态，才有能力经营好家庭。他也希望公司的福利成就员工的美好生活，「而不只是帮助大家过苦难生活」。

Regarding the relationship between employees and the company, Yu Donglai believes that the company is merely a vehicle and a destiny for employee growth, not a reliance for life; everyone should be the master of their own life. He also encouraged employees to cultivate professional skills and introduced plans to promote the construction of Xuchang sports facilities, including basketball courts, badminton courts, football fields, and swimming pools. 谈到员工与企业的关系，于东来认为，企业只是员工成长的载体与缘分，不能成为人生的依托，每个人都应成为自己生命的主人。他还鼓励员工培养专业技能，并介绍了推动许昌体育设施建设的计划，包括篮球场、羽毛球场、足球场和游泳馆。

item.title: 小鹏 G9L 上市，纯电版限时 23.18 万元起
item.guid: 小鹏-G9L-上市，纯电版限时-23.18-万元起
item.description:
The Xpeng G9L was officially launched on the evening of September 17, positioned as a large five-seater SUV, offering both pure electric and extended-range powertrains. The limited-time promotional prices for the four pure electric configurations range from 231,800 to 309,800 yuan, while the two extended-range configurations are priced at 249,800 yuan and 299,800 yuan. 小鹏 G9L 于 9 月 17 日晚正式上市，定位大五座 SUV，提供纯电和增程两种动力。纯电版四款配置的限时优惠价为 23.18 万至 30.98 万元，增程版两款配置为 24.98 万元和 29.98 万元。

The new car has a length of 5120mm, a wheelbase of 3100mm, a trunk volume of 1152L, and a 230L sunken storage space. The cabin is equipped with independent zero-gravity seats in the second row, a 21.4-inch 3K entertainment screen, and a 12.5L dual-zone refrigerator. Both front and rear seats can recline simultaneously with one click. 新车车长 5120mm、轴距 3100mm，后备厢容积为 1152L，并设有 230L 下沉储物空间。座舱配备二排独立零重力座椅、21.4 英寸 3K 娱乐屏及 12.5L 双温区冰箱，前后排座椅可一键同时舒躺。

    Power and Charging: All models adopt an 800V platform and support 5C charging. All extended-range versions are four-wheel drive, with a CLTC pure electric range of 435km and a comprehensive range of 1602km; the pure electric version has a maximum CLTC range of 755km.

    Chassis: All models come standard with dual-chamber air suspension, DCC variable damping shock absorbers, and two-way 15° rear-wheel steering, with a minimum turning radius of 5.4 meters.

    Assisted Driving: Debuting with the second-generation VLA new version, supporting 30 seconds of historical context and 6 seconds of future trajectory prediction. Max, Ultra SE, and Ultra configurations use one, two, and three Turing AI chips respectively, with Max equipped with a distilled model.

🔗 Related Reading: Starting from 231,800 yuan, Xpeng G9L officially launched, Wang Fengying: No rivals globally! 🔗 相关阅读： 23.18 万元起，小鹏 G9L 正式上市，王凤英：全球无对手！

item.title: 小米澎湃 OS 4 将于 10 月 15 日开始推送正式版
item.guid: 小米澎湃-OS-4-将于-10-月-15-日开始推送正式版
item.description:
Xiaomi announced the upgrade plan for existing devices to the official version of HyperOS 4. The first batch of pushes will start on October 15, with subsequent batches extending until December, covering mobile phones, tablets, TVs, and watches. 小米公布澎湃 OS 4 正式版的存量设备升级计划，首批推送从 10 月 15 日开始，后续批次延续至 12 月，手机、平板、电视和手表均在覆盖范围内。

According to IT Home, the first batch includes Xiaomi 17 Ultra and Leica Edition, REDMI K100 Pro Max, REDMI K90 Pro Max and Champion Edition; devices such as Xiaomi 15 Ultra, REDMI K80 Pro, Xiaomi Pad 7 Ultra are scheduled to receive pushes starting no later than November 15. 据 IT 之家报道，首批名单包括 Xiaomi 17 Ultra 及徕卡版、REDMI K100 Pro Max、REDMI K90 Pro Max 及冠军版；Xiaomi 15 Ultra、REDMI K80 Pro、Xiaomi Pad 7 Ultra 等设备安排在不晚于 11 月 15 日开始陆续推送。

Earlier models such as Xiaomi 14 Ultra, Xiaomi 14 Pro, REDMI K70 Pro, as well as Xiaomi Watch S4 eSIM and 41mm versions, are scheduled to start receiving upgrades within December. The times for each batch indicate the opening of the push window, not that all devices will receive updates simultaneously on the same day. Xiaomi 14 Ultra、Xiaomi 14 Pro、REDMI K70 Pro 等较早机型，以及 Xiaomi Watch S4 eSIM 和 41mm 版本，安排在 12 月内开始陆续升级。各批次的时间是开启推送窗口，并非所有设备当天同时收到更新。

The Xiaomi HyperOS Announcement also reminds users that this account is the only official release announcement account for the Xiaomi Community, and users can check subsequent release information in the HyperOS circle within the Xiaomi Community. 小米澎湃 OS 公告君同时提醒，该账号是小米社区唯一的官方发版公告账号，用户可以在小米社区的澎湃 OS 圈查看后续发版信息。

item.title: ColorOS 17 发布，新增小布紧急来电与记忆后台
item.guid: ColorOS-17-发布，新增小布紧急来电与记忆后台
item.description:
OPPO released ColorOS 17 on September 17, updating its fluid design, Aurora and Tidal engines, and adding memory retention. The official statement claims that the application's full retention rate has increased by 55.6%. OPPO 于 9 月 17 日发布 ColorOS 17，更新流体设计、极光与潮汐引擎，并加入记忆后台。官方称，应用完全保活率提升 55.6%。

    Xiaobu has integrated over 150 services from more than 40 partners, covering over 700 scenarios. In emergency situations like going to the wrong airport, Xiaobu can remind users via incoming calls; Flash Notes now supports processing information such as pickup codes, contacts, and concert ticket grabbing.

    AI Photo Editor supports natural language photo editing, AI Notes can process recordings, scanned content, and imported links/documents; the system also includes Care Mode, AI Anti-Fraud, and accessibility screen reading functions.

    Device interconnection supports seamless transitions between in-car navigation and pedestrian navigation, and headphones can perform AI conversation translation. OPPO Watch is also upgraded, with Fluid Cloud and Xiaobu suggestions transferable to the watch.

Find X10, OnePlus 16, and OPPO Watch S2 will be the first to launch the new system. Existing devices will receive the official version in batches starting from October 8, with the first batch including Find N6, Find X9, OnePlus 15 / 15T, and Realme GT8 Pro; the time when different devices receive updates may vary. Find X10、一加 16 和 OPPO Watch S2 将首发新系统。现有设备从 10 月 8 日起分批推送正式版，首批包括 Find N6、Find X9、一加 15 / 15T 和真我 GT8 Pro；不同设备收到更新的时间可能不同。

item.title: 智谱让 GLM 参与优化自身推理系统，十万卡部署不到两周完成
item.guid: 智谱让-GLM-参与优化自身推理系统，十万卡部署不到两周完成
item.description:
Zhipu AI disclosed on September 17 a case of GLM-5.3 participating in the construction and optimization of the GLM-5.3-Flash inference infrastructure. The team built a production-grade service from scratch on over 100,000 domestic AI accelerators, completing deployment from first run to production in less than two weeks, with end-to-end throughput approximately three times higher than the initial baseline. 智谱 9 月 17 日公开了 GLM-5.3 参与建设与优化 GLM-5.3-Flash 推理基础设施的案例。团队在超过 10 万颗国产 AI 加速器上从零搭建生产级服务，不到两周完成从首次运行到生产部署，端到端吞吐量相比初始基线约提升三倍。

This optimization was jointly completed by engineers and an Infra Agent driven by GLM-5.3. The Agent's work includes locating precision errors in long-context computation, tracking lock contention at Python and C++ boundaries, and learning optimization methods from existing open-source kernels. Related precision fixes have been merged into Flash Linear Attention. 此次优化由工程师与 GLM-5.3 驱动的 Infra Agent 共同完成。Agent 的工作包括定位长上下文计算中的精度误差，追踪 Python 与 C++ 边界上的锁竞争，以及从既有开源内核中学习优化方法。相关精度修复已合并到 Flash Linear Attention。

Zhipu AI refers to the key mechanism as "dense feedback": allowing the Agent to directly call local correctness tests, execution tracing, and micro-benchmarks, using low-cost, objectively verifiable experiments to check each hypothesis, and then confirming real service benefits through end-to-end tests. 智谱将关键机制称为「密集反馈」：让 Agent 直接调用局部正确性测试、执行跟踪和微基准，用成本较低、可客观验证的实验检查每个假设，再通过端到端测试确认真实服务收益。

🔗 Related Reading: Just now, Zhipu AI's first RSI achievement released: 100,000 domestic cards used GLM to build GLM 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，智谱首个 RSI 成果发布，10 万国产卡用 GLM 造 GLM

item.title: Snap Specs 眼镜开放预订，2195 美元起
item.guid: Snap-Specs-眼镜开放预订，2195-美元起
item.description:
Snap announced the experience and partnership plans for its next-generation Specs AR smart glasses, now open for pre-order at $2195, requiring a $200 refundable deposit, with shipments expected later this fall in the US, UK, and France. Snap 公布新一代 Specs AR 智能眼镜的体验与合作计划，现已开放预订，售价 2195 美元，需支付 200 美元可退还定金，预计今年秋季晚些时候在美国、英国和法国发货。

The glasses integrate computing hardware within the frame, eliminating the need for external processors or cables, and support gesture and voice control. The main experiences announced include: 眼镜将计算硬件集成于镜框内，无需外接处理器或线缆，支持手势和语音操作。此次公布的主要体验包括：

    Video and Shared Entertainment: The browser supports a virtual large screen, which officially claims to be equivalent to watching a 115-inch screen from a distance of 3 meters; two wearers can share experiences such as chess, table tennis, and AR dominoes in the same space.

    Daily Tools: Real-time translation supports 60 languages, and walking navigation can superimpose routes onto the field of view; Shopify Catalog can display products in 1:1 scale in real space for pre-purchase viewing.

    Office and Enterprise: Supports wireless connection to computers, Bluetooth keyboards, and Whiteboard. Snap collaborates with Salesforce, AWS, Nvidia, and others to expand applications in factories, stores, and field operations.

Snap also launched Specs Intelligence, which runs across iPhone, Mac, and glasses. Users in the US aged 18 and above can download the iOS preview to gain personal time and attention insights via Gmail and Google Calendar. Snap 同时推出跨 iPhone、Mac 和眼镜运行的 Specs Intelligence。美国年满 18 周岁的用户可下载 iOS 预览版，通过 Gmail 和 Google Calendar 获得个人时间与注意力洞察。

The separately sold cellular charging case can provide four additional charges, and the set is priced at $2395. 另售的蜂窝网络充电盒可额外充电四次，套装售价 2395 美元。

item.title: 戴森 Nurovi 扫地机器人开售，三款机型 550 美元起
item.guid: 戴森-Nurovi-扫地机器人开售，三款机型-550-美元起
item.description:
According to WIRED, Dyson's Nurovi robot vacuum series, announced earlier this month, has begun sales, including the R1 (vacuum only), R2 (vacuum and mop), and R3 (with UV light stain recognition). 据 WIRED 报道，戴森本月早些时候公布的 Nurovi 扫地机器人系列已开始销售，包含只吸尘的 R1、吸拖一体的 R2，以及加入紫外光污渍识别的 R3。

    R1 Nurovi Dry: Priced at $550, it uses LiDAR navigation and is aimed at homes primarily with carpets or floors that do not require mopping.

    R2 Nurovi Wash+Dry: Priced at $700, it has a suction power of 21000Pa, uses a triangular mop, and is sold as a Costco exclusive product, requiring membership.

    R3 Nurovi Spot+Scrub UV: Priced at $1200, it has a suction power of 30000Pa and uses UV light to help detect floor stains; Dyson states its AI can identify up to 200 types of household substances and continuously clean.

All three products feature a light gray appearance and LiDAR navigation, retaining Dyson's canister-style base station structure, and use the Twin-Capture system to collect dust and debris from hard floors and carpets. R1 and R3 are sold on Dyson's official website, while R2 is exclusive to Costco channels. 三款产品都采用浅灰色外观和激光雷达导航，保留戴森罐式基站结构，并使用 Twin-Capture 系统收集硬地面及地毯上的灰尘和碎屑。R1 与 R3 在戴森官网销售，R2 则限定在 Costco 渠道。

item.title: WorkBuddy 5.5.6 支持生成全栈云应用，免费版可开通 10 个
item.guid: WorkBuddy-5.5.6-支持生成全栈云应用，免费版可开通-10-个
item.description:
WorkBuddy released version 5.5.6, adding full-stack web application generation: by stating requirements in a conversation, an application with cloud database, file storage, login, and model calling capabilities can be generated and then published as an accessible link. WorkBuddy 发布 5.5.6 版本，新增全栈网页应用生成：在对话中提出需求，即可生成带云数据库、文件存储、登录及模型调用能力的应用，再发布为可访问链接。

According to the official introduction, cloud services will only be activated after explicit user confirmation; existing static web pages can also be upgraded to include login and data storage. After an application is published, further modifications can be made while the access address remains unchanged. Users can take applications offline and view operational statistics on the application management page within data management. 据官方介绍，用户明确确认后才会开通云服务；已有静态网页也可升级，补上登录和数据存储。应用发布后继续修改，访问地址保持不变，用户可在数据管理中的应用管理页面下线应用、查看运营统计。

The free version allows up to 10 cloud service applications, with each application providing 5000 resource points per month. Data storage, files, peak access, and model calls may all consume resource points. When membership expires or the quota is exhausted, applications will be suspended, data will be retained for 15 days, and will be permanently deleted if overdue. 免费版最多可开通 10 个云服务应用，每个应用每月提供 5000 资源点，数据存储、文件、峰值访问和模型调用均可能消耗资源点。会员到期或额度耗尽时，应用会暂停，数据保留 15 天，逾期将被永久删除。

item.title: Grok Build 新增长期记忆，可用 /dream 整理项目经验
item.guid: Grok-Build-新增长期记忆，可用-/dream-整理项目经验
item.description:
Grok officially announced that its programming tool, Grok Build, now features long-term memory, capable of saving project specifications, key decisions, and facts across sessions. Users can browse memories via /memory and then organize them by topic using /dream. Grok 官方宣布，编程工具 Grok Build 新增长期记忆，能够跨会话保存项目规范、关键决策与事实。用户可通过 /memory 浏览记忆，再用 /dream 按主题整理。

Grok Build is a programming agent based on Grok 4.6, supporting AGENTS files, plugins, hooks, and MCP. The official product page states that its plan mode first formulates a scheme, and all code edits require approval; /skillify can organize reusable operational processes into skills. Grok Build 是基于 Grok 4.6 的编程智能体，支持 AGENTS 文件、插件、hooks 与 MCP。官方产品页介绍，其 plan 模式会先制定方案，所有代码编辑均须审批；/skillify 则可将可复用的操作流程整理成技能。

item.title: Kimi 发布金融方案，接入 10 余个数据源与 9 项金融技能
item.guid: Kimi-发布金融方案，接入-10-余个数据源与-9-项金融技能
item.description:
Moonshot AI released the Kimi Financial Industry AI Solution, integrating professional data sources, financial skills, and compliance checks into a single workflow, targeting institutions such as securities firms, banks, insurance companies, and asset management firms, and also opening relevant plugins and skills to individual users. 月之暗面发布 Kimi 金融行业 AI 解决方案，将专业数据源、金融技能及合规检查接入同一工作流，面向证券、银行、保险和资产管理等机构，也向个人用户开放相关插件与技能。

The solution includes over 10 data sources such as Wind, Eastmoney, S&P Global, Cailian Press, and Caixin Data, integrated into research tasks via MCP; 9 financial skills cover financial modeling, research reports, financial statement reviews, portfolio reviews, and holdings morning reports, producing editable Excel, PPT, or Word materials. 方案包含 Wind 万得、东方财富、标普全球、财联社和财新数据等 10 余个数据源，通过 MCP 接入研究任务；9 项金融技能覆盖财务建模、研究报告、财报点评、组合复盘和持仓早报等，产出可继续修改的 Excel、PPT 或 Word 材料。

Kimi and China Securities Co., Ltd. also piloted a "temporary entrusted report generation" intelligent agent to handle issuer announcement identification, bond screening, and report draft creation. According to Kimi, the pilot covered over 50 issuers, more than 100 outstanding corporate bonds, and over 60 reports, reducing the manual production time for a single report from approximately 30 minutes to 10 minutes. Kimi 与中信建投证券还试点了「临时受托报告生成」智能体，处理发行人公告识别、债券筛选及报告初稿制作。据 Kimi 披露，试点覆盖 50 余家发行人、100 余只存续公司债券的 60 余份报告，单份报告的人工制作时间由约 30 分钟缩短至 10 分钟。

The jointly built risk assessment gateway covers data classification, personal information protection, access authorization, output verification, and audit traceability. Generated materials still require review by business personnel and do not directly form project conclusions; business judgments continue to follow existing institutional approval processes. 双方共建的风险评估网关覆盖数据分级、个人信息保护、访问授权、输出核验与审计追溯。生成材料仍需业务人员复核，不直接形成立项结论，业务判断继续遵循机构既有审批流程。

item.title: QuiverAI 推出 Arrow 2，可生成、编辑并制作 SVG 动画
item.guid: QuiverAI-推出-Arrow-2，可生成、编辑并制作-SVG-动画
item.description:
QuiverAI released Arrow 2 and Arrow 2 Telos, updating its generative models and application workspace for vector graphics. Both models are now available via App and API. QuiverAI 发布 Arrow 2 及 Arrow 2 Telos，更新面向矢量图形的生成模型与应用工作区。两款模型已通过 App 和 API 开放。

According to official introduction, Arrow 2 has improved generation speed and graphic quality, using fewer, more precise control points, reducing redundant nodes and overlapping paths, and improving element spacing and alignment. It can convert bitmaps into editable SVGs, and can also generate new variants based on reference images, preserving color schemes and graphic styles. 据官方介绍，Arrow 2 提升了生成速度和图形质量，使用更少、更精确的控制点，减少冗余节点与重叠路径，并改善元素间距和对齐。它可以将位图转换为可编辑的 SVG，也能基于参考图保留配色及图形风格，生成新的变体。

Animation capabilities directly apply to existing shapes and groups in SVG, suitable for flat materials such as logo displays, loading states, product illustrations, and dynamic icons. The new application places generation and editing in the same workspace, supporting iterative adjustments through dialogue and then fine-tuning on the canvas. 动画能力直接作用于 SVG 中已有的形状和分组，适用于标志展示、加载状态、产品插画及动态图标等平面素材。新应用将生成和编辑放在同一工作区，支持通过对话迭代，再在画布上精细调整。

Arrow 2 Telos addresses more complex styles, compositions, and long-term needs, combining the speed of foundational models with further refinement capabilities. The official recommendation is to choose Arrow 2 when speed and per-item cost are priorities, and use Telos for complex creative demands. Arrow 2 Telos 面向更复杂的风格、构图和长需求，结合基础模型的速度与进一步打磨能力。官方建议，在速度和单件成本优先时选择 Arrow 2，复杂创意需求则使用 Telos。

item.title: Rene 上线 iMessage 多人智能体，可与朋友的助手协调安排
item.guid: Rene-上线-iMessage-多人智能体，可与朋友的助手协调安排
item.description:
Second Enlightenment has launched a personal intelligent agent, Rene, which users can use directly by sending messages via iMessage, without needing to install another app or register an account. Founder Xue Tianlu stated in the launch post that the product has been tested in his own text messages for four months. Second Enlightenment 推出个人智能体 Rene，用户直接通过 iMessage 发消息使用，不需要另装应用或注册账号。创始人薛天禄在发布帖中称，产品已在自己的短信中测试了四个月。

Rene comes with a browser and can write code, build websites, create slides and images, and also handle shopping and meeting preparations. Xue Tianlu cited test scenarios including finding a new office, preparing meeting materials, and soliciting team choices for dinner. Rene 配有浏览器，可以编写代码、搭建网站、制作幻灯片及图片，也能处理购物与会议准备。薛天禄举出的测试场景包括寻找新办公室、准备会议资料，以及向团队征集聚餐选择。

Multi-user collaboration is one of its main designs. The official website demonstrates the process of two users' Renes coordinating free time and arranging dinner, and also shows scenarios like adjusting calendars, drafting replies, and searching for restaurants after reading emails; for actions involving reservations, the example will first confirm with the user. 多人协作是它的主要设计之一。官网演示了两个用户的 Rene 相互协调空闲时间、安排晚餐的流程，也展示了读取邮件后调整日历、起草回复和查询餐厅的场景；涉及订位等动作，示例会先向用户确认。

The official website states that user data will not be used for model training, nor will it be sold or shared without permission; email and calendar are connected via delegated authorization, and Rene does not read or save user passwords. 官网表示，用户数据不会用于模型训练，也不会在未经许可的情况下出售或分享；邮箱和日历通过委托授权连接，Rene 不读取或保存用户密码。

item.title: 百灵介绍 OmniTable 数据治理系统，一项任务由 14 天缩短至 2.5 天
item.guid: 百灵介绍-OmniTable-数据治理系统，一项任务由-14-天缩短至-2.5-天
item.description:
The Bailing large model introduced the OmniTable system for PB-scale large model data governance and exploration. It unifies data from different sources and derived features into a single logical wide table, while underlying storage and computation continuously adjust, reducing researchers' operations for table creation, pipeline orchestration, and data version tracking. 百灵大模型介绍了面向 PB 级大模型数据治理与探索的 OmniTable 系统。它将不同来源的数据和衍生特征统一为一张逻辑宽表，底层存储与计算则持续调整，减少研究人员建表、编排流水线和追踪数据版本的操作。

The official article listed a real SFT data governance task: gathering 8 data sources and producing 12 features. The original process for data ingestion, feature computation, filtering, and export totaled approximately 14 days; after using OmniTable, the same task takes about 2.5 days, and manual steps are reduced from approximately 45 to about 12. 官方文章列出了一项真实的 SFT 数据治理任务：汇集 8 个数据源，生产 12 项特征，原流程的数据接入、特征计算、筛选与导出合计约需 14 天；使用 OmniTable 后，同一任务约需 2.5 天，人工操作步骤从约 45 个减少至约 12 个。

This set of times measures the data governance cycle before training, does not include full model training, and cannot directly prove an improvement in model effectiveness. The system automatically handles feature dependencies, CPU/GPU task scheduling, and anomalous data isolation, and records data sources, processing procedures, and versions for easy traceability in subsequent experiments. 这组时间衡量的是训练前的数据治理周期，不包含完整的模型训练，也不能直接证明模型效果提升。系统会自动处理特征依赖、CPU / GPU 任务调度和异常数据隔离，并记录数据来源、处理过程及版本，方便后续实验追溯。

According to Bailing, OmniTable currently manages over 35 PB of data, covering more than 305 billion records, including web pages, code, PDFs, and SFT data. The abstract of the published paper also lists a production scale of 35 PB and the result of this task being shortened from 14 days to 2.5 days. 据百灵介绍，OmniTable 目前管理超过 35 PB 数据、覆盖超过 3050 亿条记录，涵盖网页、代码、PDF 和 SFT 数据。已公开论文的摘要也列出了 35 PB 的生产规模和这项任务从 14 天缩短至 2.5 天的结果。

item.title: 瑞幸、蜜雪冰城供应商唯可鲜启动上市辅导
item.guid: 瑞幸、蜜雪冰城供应商唯可鲜启动上市辅导
item.description:
According to 21st Century Business Herald, Shandong Weikexian, a supplier to Luckin Coffee and Mixue Bingcheng, has completed its listing guidance filing with the Beijing Stock Exchange. However, while the beverage ingredient company's revenue continued to grow in the first half of this year, its net profit attributable to the parent company decreased by more than 20%. 据 21 世纪经济报道，瑞幸咖啡、蜜雪冰城的供应商山东唯可鲜已完成北交所上市辅导备案。不过，这家饮品原料企业今年上半年收入仍在增长，归母净利润却下降了两成多。

The company's operating revenue in the first half of this year was 504 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 25.23%; net profit attributable to the parent company was approximately 33.2 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 22.77%. The gross profit margins for both its freshly prepared beverage ingredients and HPP ready-to-drink beverage businesses declined. 公司今年上半年营业收入为 5.04 亿元，同比增长 25.23%；归母净利润约 3320 万元，同比下降 22.77%。其现制饮品原料与 HPP 即饮饮品业务毛利率均出现下降。

Weikexian primarily supplies raw materials such as concentrated fruit juice, jams, and tea beverages. Last year, Mixue Bingcheng and Luckin Coffee together contributed nearly 60% of its revenue. The company is also expanding its HPP ready-to-drink beverage business, launching watermelon juice, mixed fruit and vegetable juices, and cold brew tea, sold through supermarkets, e-commerce, and other channels. HPP, or High-Pressure Processing, is a cold sterilization method that reduces the impact of high-temperature treatment on beverage flavor. 唯可鲜主要供应果汁浓浆、果酱、茶饮料等原料，去年蜜雪冰城与瑞幸咖啡合计贡献接近六成收入。公司也在扩大 HPP 即饮饮品业务，推出西瓜汁、混合果蔬汁及冷萃茶，并经商超、电商等渠道销售。HPP 即超高压冷杀菌，可减少高温处理对饮品风味的影响。

The company signed a guidance agreement with Sinolink Securities on August 28, and subsequently submitted filing materials. Listing guidance is still an preliminary procedure, and subsequent approval by the Beijing Stock Exchange and registration with the CSRC are required. 公司于 8 月 28 日与国金证券签署辅导协议，随后提交备案材料。上市辅导仍是前期程序，后续须通过北交所审核与证监会注册。

item.title: 罗永浩否认为钟薛高重启造势，参展物料早于相关微博
item.guid: 罗永浩否认为钟薛高重启造势，参展物料早于相关微博
item.description:
According to Xin Huanghe, after Zhongxuegao announced its brand relaunch, some netizens questioned whether Luo Yonghao's previous comments on Mr. Savage ice cream, mentioning 'missing Zhongxuegao,' were related to the brand's relaunch. Luo Yonghao publicly denied it multiple times and responded that the ice cream expo was an industry event and had been arranged long ago. 据新黄河报道，钟薛高宣布品牌重启后，有网友质疑罗永浩此前评价野人先生冰淇淋、提到「怀念钟薛高」，是否与品牌重启有关。罗永浩多次公开否认，并回应称，冰淇淋博览会是行业活动，早已安排。

The controversy stems from several consecutive timelines: On September 12, Luo Yonghao posted on Weibo after tasting Mr. Savage at the airport, saying, 'It tastes much worse than Zhongxuegao, I miss Zhongxuegao'; On September 15, news broke that Zhongxuegao had changed owners and would participate in the Tianjin Ice Cream Expo; On September 16, the brand officially announced its relaunch. During this period, Luo Yonghao also revisited past controversies surrounding Zhongxuegao, such as 'doesn't melt' and 'buy it or not'. 争议源于几个接连出现的时间点：9 月 12 日，罗永浩在机场试吃野人先生后发微博，称「感觉比钟薛高难吃多了，怀念钟薛高」；9 月 15 日，钟薛高更换新东家、将参加天津冰淇淋博览会的消息公开；9 月 16 日，品牌正式宣布重启。罗永浩期间也再次谈及钟薛高过去的「烧不化」「爱买不买」等争议。

Xin Huanghe reporters reviewed public materials from the 28th China Ice Cream and Frozen Food Industry Expo since July and found that a version of the exhibition hall map released on July 27 had already marked 'Zhongxuegao' at location N6 Corridor T919, more than a month before Luo Yonghao's Weibo post on September 12. 新黄河记者回溯第 28 届中国冰淇淋及冷冻食品产业博览会自 7 月以来的公开物料发现，7 月 27 日发布的一版展馆图已在 N6 连廊 T919 位置标注「钟薛高」，早于罗永浩 9 月 12 日的微博一个多月。

item.title: 张艺谋将任釜山电影节主竞赛评审团主席，毕赣加入评审
item.guid: 张艺谋将任釜山电影节主竞赛评审团主席，毕赣加入评审
item.description:
According to The Hollywood Reporter, Zhang Yimou will serve as the president of the main competition jury for the 31st Busan International Film Festival, leading a seven-member jury to select the 13 films nominated for this year. 据《好莱坞报道者》报道，张艺谋将担任第 31 届釜山国际电影节主竞赛评审团主席，带领 7 人评审团评选本届入围的 13 部影片。

The jury also includes Chinese director Bi Gan, Korean actress Moon Choi, Japanese director Kei Ishikawa, Korean director Jung Ju-ri, Vietnamese producer Tran Thi Bich Ngoc, and Kazakh actress Samal Yeslyamova. Bi Gan's 'Long Day's Journey into Night' won a special award at the Cannes Film Festival last year and an artistic contribution award at the inaugural Busan main competition. 评审团还包括中国导演毕赣、韩国演员 Moon Choi、日本导演石川庆、韩国导演郑朱莉、越南制片人 Tran Thi Bich Ngoc，以及哈萨克斯坦演员萨玛尔 · 叶斯利亚莫娃。毕赣的《狂野时代》去年曾获戛纳电影节特别奖，并在釜山首届主竞赛中获得艺术贡献奖。

The Busan Film Festival established a new main competition section in 2025, and this year marks its second edition, where awards for Best Film, Best Director, Jury Special Award, Best Actor, and Artistic Contribution Award will be presented. Zhang Yimou has previously collaborated with Busan; his directed film 'Under the Hawthorn Tree' was the opening film of the festival in 2010. 釜山电影节于 2025 年设立新的主竞赛单元，今年是第二届，将颁发最佳影片、最佳导演、评审团特别奖、最佳演员及艺术贡献奖。张艺谋此前与釜山也有合作，他执导的《山楂树之恋》曾于 2010 年成为电影节开幕片。

This year's film festival will be held from October 6th to 15th, with the Asian Contents & Film Market taking place concurrently from October 10th to 13th. 本届电影节将于 10 月 6 日至 15 日举行，亚洲内容与电影市场同期于 10 月 10 日至 13 日举办。

item.title: 广电总局将扶持真人微短剧，平台须开设专区并加强 AI 剧审核
item.guid: 广电总局将扶持真人微短剧，平台须开设专区并加强-AI-剧审核
item.description:
On September 17, the National Radio and Television Administration (NRTA) stated at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office that live-action dramas remain the main force in the creation of high-quality micro-dramas, and it will guide platforms to set up dedicated live-action drama zones and increase financial support. 9 月 17 日，广电总局在国新办发布会上表示，真人剧仍是微短剧精品创作的主力，将指导平台开设真人剧专区，并加大资金扶持力度。

According to Cailian Press, Wang Xiaoliang, Director of the NRTA's Network Audio-Visual Program Management Department, introduced that approximately 430,000 micro-dramas were launched in the first eight months of this year, which is 13 times the total for last year, with over 90% being AI-generated dramas. The user base for micro-dramas has exceeded 800 million. 据财联社报道，广电总局网络视听司司长王小亮介绍，今年前 8 个月上线微短剧约 43 万部，是去年全年的 13 倍，其中 AI 剧超过九成。微短剧用户规模已超过 8 亿。

In response to the rapidly growing number of AI-generated dramas, the NRTA requires the implementation of content labeling, clarification of bottom lines such as portrait and voice authorization, and strengthening of full-process content review. This year, approximately 68,000 non-compliant micro-dramas have been removed, and over 1,200 non-compliant accounts have been dealt with, with more than 90% of the non-compliant content being AI-generated dramas. 针对快速增长的 AI 剧，广电总局要求落实内容标识，明确肖像、声音授权等底线，并加强全流程内容审核。今年已下架违规微短剧约 6.8 万部，处置违规账号超过 1200 个，九成以上违规内容为 AI 剧。

item.title: 《孤岛惊魂》剧集新增五名演员，每季讲述独立故事
item.guid: 《孤岛惊魂》剧集新增五名演员，每季讲述独立故事
item.description:
According to a Deadline report on September 17, FX's video game adaptation series 'Far Cry' has added five new cast members: Brendan Gleeson, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Hamish Linklater, Sam Spruell, and Jamie Demetriou. 据 Deadline 9 月 17 日报道，FX 的游戏改编剧集《孤岛惊魂》（Far Cry）新增布兰登 · 格里森、詹妮弗 · 杰森 · 李、哈米什 · 林克莱特、萨姆 · 斯普鲁尔及杰米 · 德米特里欧五名演员。

They will co-star with previously announced Rob McElhenney, Lizzy Caplan, and Steve Buscemi. The series is adapted from Ubisoft's game series of the same name, created in collaboration by Noah Hawley, the showrunner of 'Fargo' and 'Alien: Earth,' and Rob McElhenney, with FX Productions handling the production. 他们将与此前公布的罗布 · 麦克、丽兹 · 卡潘和史蒂夫 · 布西密共同出演。该剧改编自育碧同名游戏系列，由《冰血暴》《异形：地球》的主创诺亚 · 霍利与罗布 · 麦克合作打造，FX Productions 负责制作。

The series will retain the standalone narrative format of the game series: each season will feature new settings and character lineups. Ubisoft's 'Far Cry' series is known for its first-person shooter gameplay, open world, and distinctive villain characters, having released six main installments from 2004 to 2021, along with multiple spin-offs and expansion content. 剧集将保留游戏系列的独立叙事形式：每季使用新的背景设定与角色阵容。育碧的《孤岛惊魂》系列以第一人称射击、开放世界和鲜明的反派角色著称，自 2004 年至 2021 年推出了六部正传，并有多部衍生作品和扩展内容。

Hawley is involved in the production through his 26 Keys company; Rob McElhenney is the creator of 'It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia' and an executive producer of 'Welcome to Wrexham,' and the Ubisoft Film & Television team is also participating in the series. 霍利通过自己的 26 Keys 公司参与制作；罗布 · 麦克是《费城永远阳光灿烂》的创作者，也是《欢迎来到雷克瑟姆》的执行制片人，育碧影视团队亦参与该剧。
